approximation_reassessment.decision: Do not substitute the public sample or unrelated 2020 collection.
approximation_reassessment.basis: The accessible paper-linked release has one original per character, not a near-complete corpus missing a few items. The other 1005-image corpus is not established as the selected target data and has no verified target selection/split lineage. Expanding one original per class into the reported train/test sizes would chiefly measure transformations of the same image, not the requested character-recognition experiment.
approximation_reassessment.remaining_gates: Exact source-data access/identity and TableI VGG16 metric inconsistency. Routine missing seed, optimizer defaults, and preprocessing details are not blocking decisions.
